rules: Existing inward layers, SDK ownership and direct-command isolation in pyproject.toml and tests/test_architecture.py; explicit effects remain in adapters.

modules.responsibility: Pure policy, private queue records and generation-aware control results.
modules.interface: Typed records and deterministic allocation; no SDK or filesystem effects.

modules.responsibility: Coordinate queue behavior through explicit ports.
modules.interface: Reasonless control operations and memory observations with exclusive live reservations.

modules.responsibility: Own generation events, locks, telemetry integration and process supervision.
modules.interface: Atomic free and exclusive admission; older generations cannot alter current capacity.

modules.responsibility: Read physical identities and memory without model runtimes.

modules.responsibility: Compose queue and standalone operator controls.
modules.interface: Index-based controls and public projections without tokens or full GPU IDs.

modules.responsibility: Render public queue status and forward actions.
modules.interface: Physical GPU labels and sanitized errors.

modules.interface: Sanitized text and JSON without private GPU UUIDs or claim tokens.

contracts.rules: Enforce inward layers, inert imports, queue SDK exclusions and direct-command isolation, including injected forbidden dependencies.

Offline regressions pass, including threshold, generation races, old guardians and public output.
